title: Assignment to the final tape slot
statement: Let $s,a$ be natural numbers, let $f$ and $g$ be functions on the first and second blocks of a combined index set of size $s+a+1$, and let $y$ be an element of their codomain. At the final, singleton index, the function assembled from $f$, $g$, and $y$ has value $y$.
